title: One Model, Two Physical Stories: Auditing Misalignment in Multi-Modal World Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.14833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models, systems that generate what happens next given current environmental conditions, are increasingly being implemented with multi-modal generation in mind. However, generating multiple modalities simultaneously, such as visual simulations alongside physical state predictions in the form of text, introduces the risk of cross-modal inconsistency. Tested separately, both outputs may look convincing while still disagreeing: a model can calculate that a ball should rebound in one modality, then generate no rebound in another modality, to say nothing of diverging from real-world dynamics entirely. In this work we focus on two failures explicitly: \emph{Internal misalignment}, the disagreement between the world model's generated video and the same world model's prediction in a different modalities, and \emph{external misalignment} the disagreement between the world model's generation and an analytic physical environment. translated_title: 一个模型，两个物理故事：审计多模态世界建模中的错位问题
translated_abstract: 世界模型是能够根据当前环境条件生成接下来会发生什么的系统，如今越来越多地在设计时就考虑了多模态生成。然而，同时生成多种模态（例如视觉模拟与文本形式的物理状态预测同时生成）会带来跨模态不一致的风险。如果分别测试，两种输出可能各自看起来都很令人信服，但彼此却相互矛盾：模型可以在一种模态中计算出球应该反弹，却在另一种模态中生成没有反弹的画面，更不用说完全偏离真实世界的物理动力学了。在这项工作中，我们明确聚焦于两种失败模式：*内部错位*，即世界模型生成的视频与同一世界模型在其他模态中预测之间的不一致；以及*外部错位*，即世界模型的生成结果与解析物理环境之间的不一致。我们推导了……
tldr: 该论文揭示了多模态世界模型的两种失败模式——内部错位（模型自身生成的视频与其他模态物理预测相互矛盾）和外部错位（模型输出偏离真实物理规律），并提出对其进行系统审计。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies and audits two failure modes in multi-modal world models—internal misalignment (contradictions between the model's own video generation and its physical predictions in other modalities) and external misalignment (divergence from real-world physical dynamics).
